pumac-2024-algebra-a-07.prompt: Let $F_1=1$, $F_2=1$, and $F_{n+2}=F_{n+1}+F_n$. Then $$S=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\arctan\!\left(\frac1{F_n}\right)\arctan\!\left(\frac1{F_{n+1}}\right).$$ Find $\lfloor80S\rfloor$. (Hint: it may be useful to note that $\arctan\left(\frac11\right)=\arctan\left(\frac12\right)+\arctan\left(\frac13\right)$.)

pumac-2024-algebra-a-08.prompt: Let $[n]$ denote the set of integers $0,1,\dots,n-1$. Let $\omega_n=e^{2\pi i/n}$. Let $$f(n)=\prod_{\substack{i\in[n]\\ \gcd(i,n)=1}}\ \prod_{\substack{j\in[n]\\ \gcd(j,n)\ne1}}\left(\omega_n^i-\omega_n^j\right).$$ Then $f(2024)=2^{e_1}\cdot11^{e_2}\cdot23^{e_3}$ for positive integers $e_1,e_2,e_3$. Find $e_1+e_2+e_3$.
